_help: Copy a block into mcp-servers.json under "servers". The key (e.g. "notion") is the server's short name.
Local program: "command" and "args". Web server: "url" and optional "headers".
Never put a key here. Write "${NAME}" and put NAME=value in envi/.env yourself.
"allow" lists the tools the models may use. Empty = the server is connected but exposes nothing.
See every tool a server offers: npm run mcp -- <name>. Allow only tools that read or make drafts.
